authority: Owner reset: market pricing, pick log, consensus filter by September 8; 300-credit cap; no model, power or teaser work before September 10. Standing engine-v2 commit/push approval.

decisions.books: BetMGM=betmgm; Caesars=williamhill_us; FanDuel=fanduel; DraftKings=draftkings. Sharp preference Pinnacle then BetOnline then LowVig among returned candidates. Priority is an operating convention, not a measured sharpness ranking. Pinnacle selected. Only BetMGM/Caesars executable.
decisions.caesars: Requested on all captures; no quotes returned. Explicit coverage gap. The provider documents Caesars as paid-subscription-only; this record does not assert why a particular quote is missing.
decisions.coverage: Fewer than two books is flagged, not a new acceptance gate. Never devig unmatched points or missing outcomes. Stale/future quotes excluded from pricing with reason.
decisions.credentials: Local existing credential consumed in memory; URL passed to curl via stdin, not argv. Exact response bodies checked for credential before persistence. Only quota/date/content-type headers retained. No credentials or keyed raw headers committed.
decisions.credits: All calls reserved atomically in a persistent ledger before dispatch. First Python transport attempt failed; its full reserved cost remains charged to the cap conservatively. System curl transport succeeded. No automatic retries. Future refreshes share the same cap.
decisions.deferred: Model, power, teaser and Tier A work deferred until September 10 or later; no frozen acceptance gate or E3 result changed.
decisions.fair_line: Closest offered consensus threshold to 50 percent for each game/market/player, deterministic lower-line tie break. No interpolation across key numbers. Moneylines have fair price rather than numeric line.
decisions.freshness: Maximum book-update age one hour at capture; preserve exact timestamps and label live snapshot, not canonical T-60.
decisions.markets: Moneyline, spreads, totals, alternate spreads/totals, passing yards/TDs, rushing yards, receiving yards and receptions. All complete returned markets in this bounded set processed; no props model or fabricated missing markets.
decisions.operations: Default command replays cached evidence without network. Explicit --refresh-mainlines makes one capped live call and produces new immutable artifacts. Full alternate/prop refresh is not scheduled. Prior snapshots preserved.
decisions.picks: Separate execution-intent/executed and paper CSV files. Approved/declined/fill are distinct append events with unique event IDs; no automatic bets or fabricated decisions. Model probability blank; consensus probability and source label populated. An executed event asserts the selected quote is the actual fill; never rewrite earlier approval.
decisions.price_edge: Continuous American cents coordinate: a+100 for negative prices, a-100 for positive prices. Executable coordinate minus fair coordinate. Both fair probability bounds inclusive; no rounding before filter.
decisions.probabilities: Unweighted median of complete-book power-devig outcome probabilities at EXACT event/market/player/line/outcome-count, renormalized across outcomes. Consensus includes the execution book. Not independent model probabilities.
decisions.pushes: Devig probabilities are conditional on represented settled outcomes. For two-way push-capable lines, unconditional push mass is unavailable without a model. Do not invent it. Three-way markets remain separate.
decisions.week: Provider kickoff window September 9 through before September 16 UTC; Week 1 label follows owner schedule scope. First returned kickoff is September 10 UTC, September 9 in US time.
